paragraphs: I am writing to express my interest in a Senior Application Developer, Technical Lead, or Mobile Application Developer position within your organization.

With over 10 years of experience in designing and delivering scalable, high-performance mobile and cross-platform applications, I specialize in React Native, .NET MAUI, Xamarin, C#, Kotlin, and backend API development. I have successfully led enterprise application development from architecture and implementation to release management and production support while mentoring teams and driving engineering excellence.

Currently, I work as a Technology Lead at Infosys, where I lead end-to-end mobile application development, build enterprise-grade solutions, and develop AI-enabled proof-of-concepts to improve engineering productivity and business outcomes. My expertise includes application architecture, performance optimization, REST API integration, Microsoft Azure, and monitoring platforms such as AppDynamics, Sentry, and Grafana.

In addition to mobile and cloud technologies, I am experienced in Generative AI, Agentic AI, Azure AI Foundry, Prompt Engineering, and AI Agent development, with hands-on experience integrating enterprise AI solutions and applying Agile AI development practices using the BMAD Method. I am passionate about building intelligent, AI-powered applications that combine modern software engineering with practical AI capabilities.

I continuously invest in expanding my expertise through professional learning and certifications. My credentials include Claude 101, Claude Code 101, Microsoft Certified: GitHub Copilot, and Microsoft Certified: Agentic AI Business Solutions Architect (In Progress).

I am confident that my combination of technical leadership, mobile application expertise, cloud technologies, and AI experience enables me to make an immediate contribution to your engineering team. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background aligns with your organization's goals.
Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to hearing from you.
